title: Ordinary module pullback balanced generators
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], $X,Y$ schemes with their small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and $f:X\to Y$. Write $R_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ for the coefficient rings [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use the internal and section module categories, fixed section equivalences and local pure tensors of [def-pd-section-module-operations-data], and the specified monoidal pullback structures of [def-pd-proetale-section-module-functors]. Define $I_f(M)=f^{-1}M$, an internal $f^{-1}R_Y$-module. For every source-site object $W$ and $x\in I_f(M)(W)$, $y\in I_f(N)(W)$, define $\tau_f(x,y)\in I_f(M\otimes_{R_Y}N)(W)$ by the inverse-image lax tensor comparison applied to the balanced pure tensor of $x,y$. For $s\in R_X(W)$ define $\sigma_f(s,x)\in(f^*M)(W)$ as the image of $s\otimes x$ under the ambient sheaf tensor map followed by the scalar-extension coequalizer projection for $f^{-1}R_Y\to R_X$. Retain as named maps the specified internal oplax tensor $\delta_{M,N}$, its strong-structure lax inverse $\mu_{M,N}$, and internal oplax unit $\eta$, and their specified section-module oplax tensor and unit maps. These are the existing constructions, with no further choices or asserted normalization equations.
